batting.dismissal: c MS Gony b A Ashish Reddy

batting.name: SS Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b V Pratap Singh

batting.name: AB de Villiers

batting.dismissal: c JP Duminy b A Ashish Reddy

balls.text: bowled him, the fast yorker on middle stump, Reddy swings across the line and misses. Vinay's ended the innings with two dot balls

Parthiv charges the bowler and swings across the line, aiming for the midwicket boundary. The shot does not come off and the ball goes in the air off the leading edge, Gayle runs back from point and judges the catch well
Reddy makes room by moving outside leg and drives to extra cover
full ball angling into the left-hander from round the wicket, the batsman moves outside leg to make room but has to play on the leg side after the bowler follows him
another full toss and another mis-timed heave, lobbing the ball towards long-off, where it falls well short of the fielder
the slow loopy bouncer outside off, a touch too wide
in the blockhole around off, played towards cow corner, Tiwary slips as he reaches the ball and concedes the second
short ball and Parthiv tries to hook, he misses and wears it on the helmet. He won't mind though because the ball has gone to the fine leg boundary

caught by the fielder running in from long on. It was a full toss but Duminy swung a touch too hard and too early, he mis-timed the shot. Appanna the substitute judged it well, taking the catch on the run
in the blockhole, Duminy plays it back to the bowler

a full toss, which Duminy hits hard into the pitch and towards the bowler, Zaheer sticks his hand out and deflects the ball to long-on, the batsmen take the risk and run the second, Parthiv would have been out by a direct hit
reaches out for a wide ball and squirts it to backward point
walks a long way across his stumps to try and paddle the ball to fine leg, the ball just missed off stump
now he goes straight, with great success. Duminy gets down on one knee and lofts the ball over the bowler's head. A third six in that Murali over
Duminy charges the bowler but gets yorked, he digs it out back to the bowler
Parthiv clubs the ball past the bowler for a single
driven to long on for a single
don't switch off your TV yet, Chennai fans. Duminy swings hard across the line once again, carting the ball over the deep midwicket boundary. A well executed slog sweep
Duminy's sussed this pitched now! He makes room and slams the ball flat over wide long on, clearing his front foot and swinging hard
a full toss which Duminy hits to long on, the fielder fumbles but Duminy had slipped at the non-striker's end
flicked firmly off the pads towards backward square leg where Tiwary runs to his left and stops the boundary in the nick of time
over extra cover! Duminy makes room by moving towards leg, clears his front foot and launches the ball over the boundary, it just cleared the rope. That's his half-century too
flicked off the pads through square leg
he swings across the line again, but this time finds the fielder at deep midwicket
a full toss, don't need the pitch to be a good one to hit this, Duminy puts it away by swinging across the line, placed it wide of long on
played off the back foot towards point
Duminy tries to steer to third man but is beaten by a slower ball outside off
ah, that's the first six! Duminy moves across his stumps, slightly forward, and hoists a length ball over wide long-on. Not a very big six, but it livens things up a bit
he moved a long way outside off to clip a full ball through square leg, once again he misses and gets hit on the pad
Parthiv backs away and tries to drive through the off side, he misses, that ball kept a bit low
Duminy stays in his crease and steers the ball to third man, using the angle across him from over the wicket, Harshal is quick to reach the ball on the boundary

Parthiv moves forward and closes the face to play on the leg side, Harshal is angling the ball across the left-hander from over the wicket and so the ball lobs on the off side after hitting the leading edge
Dumony moves forward and outside off to work the ball to long on
short ball on the pads, Duminy plays a short-arm pull into the gap on the square leg boundary, hit that off the front foot
played back to the bowler
Parthiv stays back and nudges the ball in front of square
length ball outside off, driven from the crease through cover and the batsmen race through for two
played off the pads behind square for a single, the umpire signals for the second time out
tries to slog sweep but that was down leg side
driven off the front foot towards cover
played towards long on for a single
pushed from in front of his stumps through cover
Duminy goes back again and cuts in front of point
slightly short outside off, hit hard off the back foot in front of point
the slower ball outside off stump, Parthiv gets beaten as he tries to steer to third man and AB gets beaten after the ball bounces a second time in front of him
Parthiv's timed this well, short-arm pulls a short ball to the long leg boundary
Duminy plays a nothing shot, a front-foot pull of sorts against a short ball, times it so badly it doesn't carry to Zaheer at mid-on
good length and straight, Parthiv defends the ball near his feet and runs, Kohli sprints in from point and tries to kick the ball on to his stumps but misses
Duminy moves across his stumps towards the off side and forces the short of a length ball off his hips through midwicket
length ball outside off, Duminy cuts hard but Kohli leaps to his right at point and brings the ball down
Parthiv prods outside off but get beaten by the turn away from him
flighted ball outside off, Duminy plays for the offbreak but it was the doosra, so it hits the inside edge and goes on the leg side
Duminy waits on the back foot and cuts to point
defended on the back foot
tossed up outside off stump, Parthiv reaches for it and drives along the ground to long off

caught at long off! Sangakkara came forward and lofted the ball, he hit it quite cleanly but just not far enough, Vinay took the catch on the edge of the boundary at head height. Sanga didn't get to the pitch of the offbreak
Duminy moves forward and outside off stump once again, he has to deal with a bouncer and misses the hook
moves forward and taps the ball towards square leg
Duminy steers a length ball towards third man
Sangakkara moves forward and hits a length ball to long off
driven on the front foot to mid off
because there are only three fielders on the leg side, Duminy moves forward and towards the off to try and swing a full ball angling across him through leg, he misses
tossed up outside off stump, Duminy stays back and swats in front of point
played off the back foot to mid off
Duminy waits on the back foot and cuts towards deep point
Sanga was looking to drive to mid off, but it went to mid on instead
Sanga goes back and cuts the ball late from off stump to point
Murali bowls this quicker and flatter and also down leg side
flighted from Murali from round the wicket, Duminy drives through cover
Duminy moves forward and towards the off to clip the ball towards mid-on
a low full toss, which Duminy drives fluently through cover, Mayank runs to his left and dives on the boundary to prevent the four
this one is inside the tram line but Duminy chooses to let it go

that's a good call from the umpire, Duminy moved towards the off side and Parameswaran bowled it wider, and therefore outside the tram line. Duminy looked expectantly at umpire Taufel who shook his head, Duminy was quite close to the ball
slower ball bowled slightly full outside off, Sanga moves forward to square drive but can't beat Dilshan at point
good length outside off, Sangakkara stays in his crease and cuts but cannot beat point
good length angling into the left-hander from round the wicket, cramping Duminy for room, the batsman moves forward and defends
Sangakkara comes forward again and nudges the good length ball in front of square
punched from the crease towards mid off
moves forward and towards the off to clip the ball off his pads towards short fine leg, where Parameswaran dives and makes a half stop
short of a length outside off, not sure Duminy wanted to place it so fine, but he steered it past the keeper for four, seemed well in control of the shot, opened the face late
played off the back foot towards backward point
the slower ball outside off, Duminy drives hard into the ground, Kohli leaps at cover to prevent it from bouncing over him
short and wide outside off, Duminy stays in his crease and cuts to wide third man
the ball keeps a bit low after pitching on a length, skidding through on Duminy who was beaten on the cut
lovely drive, the ball was full outside off stump, Duminy moved forward and leaned into the drive, placing it through the gap at extra cover
Duminy moves forward and drives a length ball firmly to cover, where the fielder collects and quickly throws at the bowler's end
length ball outside off, Sanga cuts firmly through point
played towards midwicket again
Sanga skips out of his crease and clips the ball through midwicket
slower and closer to the batsman, Sanga goes back and blocks
quicker ball bowled fuller outside off stump, Sanga lets it go and watches it spin sharply away from him
Duminy strides forward and drives to long off
tossed up around off, Duminy moves forward and defends
cut off the back foot to point once again
short of a length outside off, Duminy stays on the back foot and square drives behind point
good length ball outside off stump, Duminy mis-times the cut to point
Duminy moves outside the line of off stump and shoulders arms

what happened there? White's been caught off a very odd shot. The length was quite short and White began to pull but realised he was too early on the shot. He then stopped his shot and turned his head away, looking towards square leg. The ball thudded into the bat and lobbed up for a simple catch to square leg. The Super Kings will be grimacing.
good length and straight, White plays back to the bowler
short of a length outside off, White cuts off the back foot to Parameswaran at third man
White tries to drive on the up to mid-off, but mis-times it towards the leg side
White steers the ball but it went finer than he expected, it went on the bounce to first slip

caught behind, Reddy's hard-hitting, mis-timed innings ends. He once again goes hard at the ball, trying to drive a short of a length delivery that seams away from him through cover. He gets an edge through to AB that is caught easily
again he tries to hit the ball too hard while driving to mid-on
Reddy charges the bowler but is greeted with a short of a length ball that he swats at, the ball hits high on the bat and lobs towards cover, it falls short of the fielder and then spins past him
short ball, but umpire Taufel says that's way too high, it was well over the batsman's head
Sangakkara moves forward and towards the off side so that Zaheer's line on off stump ends up on the batsman's pads, Sanga then clips the ball fine, beating the diving fielder at short fine leg
Sanga steps out to a short of a length ball and taps it towards point
played off the back foot towards midwicket
in the slot for the cover drive outside off stump, Zaheer went round the wicket and angled the ball into the right-hander, Reddy tries to hit a bit too hard and doesn't find the gap at cover
fuller length outside off stump, Reddy drives hard but places it to mid-off
Sanga plays the ball towards mid-on
Vinay pitches on a good length outside off and gets the ball to lift sharply, beating the bat
Reddy drives hard at a length ball outside off and places it through point, Dilshan dived to his right and got a hand on it, taking the pace off the shot and preventing the four
Sanga walks forward and towards the off side to tap the ball off his pads towards the leg side
played from the crease towards point
defended back to the bowler
pushed towards midwicket for another risky single. Had Tiwary hit at the bowler's end, there would have been a run-out

Has Dhawan been bowled? He has been. No one noticed at first. Zaheer's delivery pitched on a good length outside off and burst between Dhawan's bat and pad. It clipped the pad so Zaheer appealed for an lbw. Umpire Taufel said not out and began to hand Zaheer his cap at the end of the over. Then one of the fielders pointed to the fallen off bail. Replays show the ball had just kissed the top of the bail as it passed to the keeper. the lightest of touches. Gayle was the fielder who noticed the bail had fallen
pushed to mid-on for a risky single but Parameswaran throws at the batsman's end, he should have been aiming at the non-striker's
Zaheer pitches short of a length and seams it away from Reddy, who pushes from his crease and is beaten outside off stump
Dhawan tries to drive at a fuller ball angling into him an gets an inside edge past leg stump
length ball angling into the left-hander, Dhawan stays in his crease and opens the face of the bat, hitting the ball into the ground through point, terrific timing
pitches on a good length outside the left-hander's off stump and held its line through to AB after Dhawan let it go

and that's that, good length and straight, the batsman slogs across the line and makes no contact. RCB have crashed out of the IPL and Super Kings are through to the playoffs. Deccan Chargers finish eighth.
he's tried to experiment and bowl a back of the hand slower ball, but it's too wide outside off, the batsman slogs and misses
it's all but over for RCB. Harshal can only drive the ball to long off. Super Kings are one ball away from the playoffs.

Murali's skied the ball high in the air, slogging at a length ball outside off stump. Duminy ran forward and to his left from long-on to judge the catch perfectly. RCB need two sixes off the remaining balls to win now.
in the blockhole this time and the batsman, Harshal, mis-times through midwicket
another slower ball and Vinay has holed out to long-on. CSK will be rejoicing. Vinay had to reach outside off stump to hit that and he dragged it straight to Duminy
a slower ball on off stump, driven along the ground to long of where White fields
a full toss, Harshal had backed away outside leg and could only hit it along the ground to long off
in the blockhole and the batsman forces it towards midwicket, Sanga throws at the bowler's end, forcing Vinay to dive
Vinay backs away and heaves at a length ball, pulling it into the gap on the cow corner boundary, keeping RCB in the chase
backs away towards leg but the bowler follows him, played to long on
swung through the leg side for a single

caught at midwicket! Tiwary's mis-timed the pull against a short ball straight up in the air. It was there to pull for six but Tiwary could not execute. Sangakkara settled under the ball and took a crucial catch. Tiwary's hand came off the bat as he played the shot. Are RCB are slipping out of the season?
Mishra draws the batsman forward and spins the googly between bat and pad. Lovely delivery to end the over
swung off the pads behind square leg

Tiwary takes a step out and drives to long on where Duminy fields. Mishra makes a poor attempt of collecting the ball and allows an overthrow. Poor from Mishra, he should have been behind the throw from Duminy
a flat and fast ball heaved towards deep midwicket where White had to run to his right and field
driven off the front foot towards long-off, Vinay is off the mark
tossed up and straight, Tiwary drives to long off for a single
in the blockhole to finish, the new batsman watchfully plays on the off side. Zaheer should have been playing like that.

middle stump has taken a beating! The ball was full and dead straight. Zaheer backed away again and slogged, exposing all three stumps. He missed and Steyn uprooted middle stump. Senseless batting really, should have just seen Steyn off.
Zaheer backs away and slogs, what's he doing? Steyn steams past the bat with a short ball.
short of a length outside off stump, Zaheer backs away and swings hard, he gets beaten
good length and very straight, Zaheer dropped the ball at his feet and began to run, the ball nearly bounced on to his stumps. Tiwary was not running
fast and straight, Tiwary pushes towards mid off and runs

he's hit it straight to long-on! And Kohli is furious with himself. He tried to clear long-on again but this time he hit it flat, instead of high. Gony moved to his right and caught it before tumbling to the ground
massive hit! Kohli gets under a length ball and lofts through the line, hitting it into the fans beyond the long-on boundary
the slower ball down leg side, played off the back foot behind square, would have been wide had the batsman let it go
good length and straight, tapped slowly off the pads into the gap at midwicket - there's no one in the circle so the batsmen rush back for two
slower ball outside off stump, Kohli goes back and hits the ball through cover
a friendly full toss, Kohli swings off the front foot and hits the ball into the gap on the deep midwicket boundary. Chargers bowlers have been poor after that time out.
good length on off stump, Tiwary stays back and plays to point
that's far too short and it's fodder for Tiwary who swivels and pulls the gentle medium-pace long hop high and far over square leg
played from the crease this time to long-on
short of a length outside off stump with slight movement away from Kohli as he tries to drive on the up through cover, he gets beaten
Tiwary walks out of his crease and pulls again, this time he mis-times the shot through midwicket
short ball on leg stump and Tiwary pulls off the front foot, placing it into the gap on the backward square leg boundary. An ideal re-start for RCB
length ball outside off, driven with power to long off, the players will take the final time out with RCB needing 56 off 36 balls
Kohli moves forward and pushes the ball to mid-on
cut off the back foot towards third man
now he tries to pull with a lot of power, but the length isn't short enough and Tiwary gets beaten outside off stump
good length ball angling across the left-hander, Tiwary tries to cut but there's not enough room for that
good length delivery angling across the left-hander, Tiwary tries to cut but there's not enough room for that
the first ball is down leg side from over the wicket ... Parthiv tumbles to his left to collect
a low full toss played to long on
a third slower ball from the back of the hand, Kohli times the drive better this time but White dives to his right at cover to save runs
another back of the hand slower ball, Kohli mis-times the cover drive, he had to reach for it outside off
played off the back foot in front of Duminy at point
length ball outside off stump, Tiwary moves forward and biffs the drive into the ground and over the fielder at cover
the slower ball out of the back of the hand, Tiwary defends from the crease on the off side
a flat short ball from Mishra, Tiwary punches off the back foot through cover
the straighter one this time, Kohli goes back and drives to long off
another flatter ball, Kohli goes back and plays to midwicket
defended back to the bowler
that's loose, a long hop, Kohli rocks back and pulls the ball over the midwicket boundary for a six that will give RCB a lot of relief
Kohli goes back and plays to cover, tight line and length
good length on middle and off, Tiwary gets behind the line and defends
a bottom edge so close to the stumps! Kohli tried to force a good length ball through the off side. No footwork and he is lucky not to be bowled
tight length on a wicket to wicket line, the batsman defends
played off the back foot towards midwicket
hit off the back foot towards point
good length on off stump, Kohli drives to point
nudged off the back foot towards square leg
bowled him! Game truly on! It was the flatter, straighter and quicker ball. Agarwal went back and tried to play on the leg side. Missed it completely and middle stump was knocked back
biffed hard into the pitch and the bounce takes it over Mishra's head
the legbreak bowled flatter and straighter, Agarwal goes back and hits to long off

caught at cover! AB's gone! A flighted ball outside off stump, sucking AB into the front foot drive. It dipped on him and AB ended up spooning it in the air. Unfortunately for him, Duminy was at cover and he was athletic enough to leap high into the air and catch the ball at full stretch over his head. Tremendous catch. Game on?
the googly and Kohli plays the ball to midwicket
in the blockhole to finish a tight over, Kohli taps it towards midwicket. The umpire signals for the time-out
a loose cover drive against a good length ball in the channel outside off stump, Kohli is beaten
the crowd thinks it's a catch but Kohli had mis-timed the drive into the ground before the ball lobbed up to point
full length on off stump, driven from the crease to mid-off's right for a quick single
steps out of his crease and drives a full ball fluently to White at mid off
AB moves outside leg stump and throws his bat at a short of a length ball outside off, he was too far away to make contact
played off the front foot in front of point
played late off the back foot to point, where Dhawan fields
defended on the front foot on the off side
driven to long off for a single
played back to the bowler

rubbish cricket from Deccan Chargers. A gentle push towards cover point has resulted in six runs. There was one throw to the bowler's end which conceded an overthrow. Then Gony backed up and threw again needlessly and this time there was no one backing up so the ball went for four more overthrows. Village.
driven on the front foot to mid off
that kept a touch low outside off, AB tries to steer behind point but was beaten
length ball outside off, Kohli moves forward and drives through cover
length ball outside off, driven from the crease through cover
short and wide outside off, cut off the back foot through point
good length outside off, AB drives through cover
short of a length outside off stump and Kohli mis-times the pull to mid-on
stays steady in his crease and pushes a good length ball to point
good length on off stump, defended on the front foot
a half-volley on the pads, Kohli flicks gracefully through midwicket but Gony has a fielder patrolling the boundary
full ball outside off, Tiwary drives off the front foot towards point where Duminy dives to his left and prevents the ball from going past him
good length just outside off, Tiwary prods and gets beaten again
good length and fast outside off, the batsman lets it go

oh ho, Tiwary is the deer in the headlights, was very late in getting out of the way of a supremely directed short ball. Tiwary fended in hope. The ball lobbed off the glove and straight to where a gully fielder would have been. Dhawan ran from first slip and dived to his left but couldn't reach it
good length slanting across the left hander, Tiwary lets it go

lbw! Dilshan looks disappointed but if there was no edge, that is plumb. Steyn bowled on a good length and very straight. Dilshan cleared his front foot and swung across the line. He was hit on the back pad in front of middle. That is plumb.
good length on off stump, Dilshan plays the ball watchfully to cover. Ten more Steyn deliveries to go
good length outside of, Dilshan moves forward and plays to cover
Kohli tries to pull but the ball isn't short enough, he was cramped for room and short on time.The ball hit him where it hurts
fuller length on middle stump, Kohli leans forward and plays towards mid-on
good length outside off, Kohli goes back and punches towards cover
pushed at it off the front foot and the good length ball hits the outside edge and runs to the third man boundary
worked off the pads through square leg
strays down leg side this time, Dilshan misses the glance
good length angling into the right-hander, the batsman tries to flick but misses and is hit on the pad
good length outside off at brisk pace, Kohli lets it go

bowled him! Steyn's won his battle. Gayle was trying not to let Steyn dictate terms. He backed away towards leg to try and smash through the off side. Steyn, however, is a little quicker than Gony. Gayle is rushed for time and he gets a bottom edge on to his stumps
fire from Steyn. A well-directed bouncer at searing pace. That was aimed at the head. Gayle ducked in the nick of time
in the air but just wide of the fielder at cover, Steyn throws his head back in anguish. Gayle goes back and taps a short of a length ball in the air but wide of Dhawan diving to his right
a touch full on the pads, Dilshan flicks towards fine leg
good length on off stump, Dilshan moves forward and plays towards midwicket

Gony does not know where to bowl, or if he does, he's not hitting his lines or lengths. Another short and wide ball outside off. Gayle frees his arms again, slashing powerfully over the cover boundary
too full and lots of width outside off, Gayle simply stays in his crease, gets under the ball and frees his arms. He hits it flat over mid-off and the ball bounces just short of the rope
there he goes! A length offering from Gony, and Gayle hammers it over wide long-on, lofting it off the front foot
another length ball outside off stump, Gayle can go back and drive with power through cover, lots of width for the batsman
good length and much closer to off stump, Gayle stays in his crease and lets it pass
after those lovely outswingers from Steyn, Gony delivers a short and wide loosener outside off stump, Gayle goes back and thumps it through cover
a loud appeal from Steyn for caught behind but no one else joined in. It was a lovely outswinger, pitching on a length that drew Dilshan into the front-foot drive and moving away to beat the bat
played from the crease towards point, that was on a good length on off stump
Dilshan drives off the front foot but ends up spooning the ball towards point, it falls short and goes past the diving fielder
this time Dilshan has a little prod at a good length ball that pitches on off and bends away from the right-hander, it beats the outside edge
Steyn pitches on a good length outside off and seams it away from the right-hander, Dilshan lets it go, that was 147 kph
length ball outside off, Gayle stays back and opens the face of the bat, steering the ball behind point, Duminy dives to his right and half-stops the ball
